title: Canva AI assistant for design files, assets and exports
h1: a canva bot for finding assets and preparing exports
description: Connect Canva to Dusk Bot for design inventories, export checks and asset upkeep. See supported actions and the limits of a connector-based workflow.
answer: a bot in dusk bot can find canva designs, inspect their details, organise assets and start exports through the canva connection. it can help prepare a design handoff using the ai you choose. this catalog is not a promise to edit every element on the canvas. begin with a named folder, design or asset and a small job.
og_line: find the design. check the export.

app.name: Canva
app.intro: there is useful work around a design before anyone changes the artwork: locating the right version, checking the available formats and collecting assets. the canva actions below support those jobs as well as bounded uploads and asset updates.

highlight.use: find designs to include in a campaign inventory
inspect the contents of the handoff folder
confirm the selected design before exporting it
check which export formats are available for that design
start the requested export rather than assuming it already exists
check the export result before calling the handoff ready
identify the asset you plan to rename
apply the asset naming and tag rules you agreed
start an upload for an asset the campaign needs
verify an upload finished before trying to use it

app.setup: connect canva in **Connected apps**, sign in on canva's page and enable the bot that handles design operations. give it a folder or design reference. begin with an inventory request so you can confirm it has found the intended material before allowing export or organisation actions.

routines_intro: these jobs are about a real design handoff. they do not ask the bot to invent a finished campaign or to publish anything.

routines.name: campaign design index
routines.message: every tuesday at 2, list the designs in my acme launch folder in canva. give me their names and references, and flag titles that make the intended version unclear. do not rename or move items.

routines.name: export readiness
routines.message: each thursday at 11, inspect the canva designs i marked for handoff in this chat. check their available export formats and propose the files to export. ask me before you change anything or start jobs. check each agreed export result before reporting completion.
routines.output: a format check and confirmed exports after your agreement

routines.name: asset naming proposals
routines.message: on the first friday of each month at 1, inspect the assets in the canva folder i linked. compare their names and tags with the naming rules in this thread. propose specific renames here. do not update tags, move assets or delete anything.
routines.when: first friday of the month at 13:00

asks:
renaming assets, moving folder items and starting design jobs are app actions, so do not expect the sending approval rule to supervise them. a reader can stay restricted to the inspection actions. a writer should receive a clear instruction such as "ask me before you change anything".

canva comment posts are sends and use the bot's sending controls. keep that separate from export work: preparing a file is not a request to post a message or share a campaign on your behalf.
cannot: offer arbitrary canvas editing from this action list. the catalog covers design creation and jobs, assets, folders and comments, but has no general action for selecting and rewriting any individual canvas element.
promise that every design has every export format. check the design's available formats with the listed action before choosing the handoff file.

start a routine when something changes in canva: composio lists no canva events, so routines here run on a schedule. it lists no triggers; use scheduled folder or export checks and keep the machine running.

sections.h: check a job instead of assuming it finished
sections.md: an export request and its finished result are separate actions. tell the bot to inspect the result before saying the file is ready. use the same pattern for uploads. if the next step is storing a deliverable in [google drive](/integrations/google-drive), connect that app separately and define the destination.

sections.h: keep the creative decision with the brief
sections.md: the bot can collect files and propose names; those steps do not decide whether the artwork fits your brief. compare this with [figma handoff work](/integrations/figma), where the available actions are different. a [social posting routine](/use-cases/social-media-posting) should begin only after you have chosen what is ready.

faq.q: can chatgpt or claude work with my canva designs?
faq.a: choose the ai for a bot in dusk bot and connect canva. the bot can use the cataloged actions you grant. that does not establish access to every feature in the canva editor.

faq.q: can it automatically export a set of designs?
faq.a: the connector can start exports and retrieve their results. name the designs, check formats first and give the routine an explicit approval instruction if you want to review jobs before they start.

faq.q: do canva checks keep running when my laptop closes?
faq.a: local routines stop during sleep or when dusk bot is closed. dusk cloud provides a running machine for scheduled checks while your own computer is off.
